description: This file contains functions for updating GUI menu options and window titles in the BORIS behavioral observation software, including enabling/disabling actions based on project and observation states.

methods.name: update_windows_title
methods.description: Updates the main window title based on current project and observation status.

methods.name: update_menu
methods.description: Enables or disables menu actions depending on project and observation states, and updates window titles and status bar labels.
